title: Blazeling Origin
description: This datapack adds a new blaze-themed Blazeling Origin to the Origins Mod!
body:
This datapack adds a new blaze-themed Origin to the Origins Mod! The Blazeling Origin shares some similarities with the Blazeborn Origin, but comes with several new powers!

Impact: 🔴🔴🔴

🟢 You can shoot fireballs—three quickly, then wait up to 8 seconds to shoot another three

🟢 You can temporarily enter a "fired up" mode that allows you to do extra damage and shoot extra fireballs

🟢 You are immune to fire damage

🟢 You can fly for a limited amount of time

🟢 You do not take fall damage

🟢 You can consume coal or charcoal, which aren't a great food source but give you buffs

🟢 You are stronger in the Nether

🟡 Your attacks set things on fire

🟡 You spawn in a Nether Fortress

🔴 You get weakness and slowness in cold biomes, snow, and water

🔴 You take damage in water and rain

🔴 You take quintuple freezing damage
